hypothesis: Long-lived admission slots can retain stale leadership while strict record-high recovery leaves too much capital idle. Test explicit periodic leadership selection, ordinary slow-trend protection, daily reinvestment after observable positive short momentum, and unit retention whenever membership is unchanged. Isolate selection from the previously failed multi-layer risk filters.

fixed_rules.ranking: causal trailing log price return at lookback, since-observed fallback
fixed_rules.admission: ready, positive rank, close above trend mean and positive five-session return
fixed_rules.exit: two consecutive closes below trend mean
fixed_rules.selection: on review or after a position exit, top ranked eligible names; unchanged membership retains economic units; new membership is equal-weight subject to existing cash/concentration limits
fixed_rules.protection: after an individual trend exit retain proceeds as cash on that close, no same-close replacement

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
execution: Identical incumbent next-open cash-only engine/costs; no intraday fills or name/date rules
limitations: Retrospective research; all failed predecessor families remain part of the search ledger; no economics are accepted by this declaration.
